name: @loom/plugin-a2ui
description: A2UI adapter — projects Loom agent surfaces onto the Google A2UI (Agent-to-UI) wire protocol v1.0 (createSurface / updateDataModel / deleteSurface) so any A2UI-compliant client can render a Loom-driven UI. Egress + inbound actions + `callFunction` bidirectional RPC (client-invoked functions with a deterministic callId, reconciled with Loom's replay grain); continuous two-way binding sync remains out of scope.
